caption: The drawing depicts a single, closed, double-panel wooden door with an arched top. Each panel of the door features three vertical sections: the top section is a rounded rectangle matching the curve of the arch, the middle and bottom sections are rectangular and each contains a diamond-shaped raised panel in the center. The wood is light brown with visible grain and several knots, along with some areas that appear more worn or damaged. The left panel has a small dark metal latch, while both panels show darkened areas around the keyhole and handle. The door is drawn in a realistic style, centered on a plain, off-white background, with no other objects present. At the bottom right of the image, the name "Rose Campbell-Carmec" is written in small, light brown script.
title: Cabinet Doors
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
